correctness.description: Test `test_csv_file_exists` passes: Test 1: Verify CSV file creation at /app/contacts.csv.
Test `test_csv_has_correct_headers` passes: Test 3: Verify CSV has correct headers (name, email).
Test `test_csv_has_10_contacts` passes: Test 2: Verify CSV has exactly 10 contacts (excluding header).
Test `test_all_have_email_addresses` passes: Test 4: Verify all contacts have valid email addresses (contain @).
Test `test_contacts_match_crm` passes: Test 5: Verify CSV contacts match the first 10 contacts with emails from CRM.

functional.description: The solution uses the EspoCRM API endpoint 'http://localhost:80' (or 'http://espocrm:80')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct EspoCRM instance

functional.description: The solution exports contacts from EspoCRM to a CSV file
functional.rationale: CRM contact export is the core functionality

functional.description: The solution creates the CSV file with correct headers (name, email)
functional.rationale: CSV format must match expected structure

robustness.description: The solution handles pagination when fetching contacts from the EspoCRM API to ensure all contacts are retrieved before filtering.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution retrieves the complete dataset from the CRM system, preventing incorrect results when the first 10 contacts with emails are not in the first page of results.

robustness.description: The solution verifies that the authentication request to EspoCRM returns a successful status code before attempting to fetch contacts.
robustness.rationale: Prevents cascading failures by ensuring authentication succeeds before proceeding with data retrieval operations, making failures easier to diagnose.

robustness.description: The solution verifies that the contact fetch request to EspoCRM returns a successful status code before processing the response data.
robustness.rationale: Prevents processing of invalid or error responses, ensuring the solution fails gracefully when the API is unavailable or returns errors.

robustness.description: The solution trims whitespace from email addresses when filtering to ensure contacts with whitespace-only email fields are excluded.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the filtering logic correctly identifies truly empty email fields versus those containing only whitespace, maintaining data quality in the output.

robustness.description: The solution handles contacts where the firstName field is missing or null by constructing the full name appropriately.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution produces valid output when contact records have missing first names, preventing crashes or malformed CSV entries.

robustness.description: The solution handles contacts where the lastName field is missing or null by constructing the full name appropriately.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution produces valid output when contact records have missing last names, preventing crashes or malformed CSV entries.
